description: Given two publicly reachable audio URLs (same content in two languages), transcribes both with Whisper and aligns them semantically into sentence pairs with timestamps and a similarity score. Use this when the user already has recordings rather than text. Free tier limits apply (2 runs / 20 min per day anonymous, ≤10 min combined per run).

audio_a_url.description: Public https URL of the first audio file (mp3/m4a/wav, ≤50MB).

audio_b_url.description: Public https URL of the second audio file.

name: align_audio
title: Align two audio files into sentence pairs
